1. Read the current grid, demonstrations, remaining caps, and feedback. Infer a rule only when supported by examples; verify candidate outputs against demos before submitting.

Preserve every other cell, including the original motif and zeros/background at non-motif positions inside the bounding box. Do not assume flood-fill or neighbor propagation: test motif translations when the grid visually consists of noisy background plus one seed object.

1. Compare repeated rows, bands, or motif copies to infer the expected continuation and the affected cells. The missing part may be a solid suffix or only selected motif-phase positions.
2. Color only continuation cells confirmed by the demonstrations. Preserve the existing motif and unrelated cells. Select repeated copies from the evidence, not from rightmost zeros or suffix length alone.
3. Check the candidate against every demonstration's changed and unchanged cells.
